original.subject: UAS-11 Incident – Forensic Report – 12:15
original.body:
Subject: UAS-11 Incident – Forensic Report – 12:15

Summary: GCS-03 firmware hash matches baseline 03.2026-B after re-imaging. The 915 MHz link was compromised via a rogue RF emitter (IP 192.168.100.22, MAC: 915-0A-1F-3C-7D-4E). The device is not in Group’s approved vendor list. Vendor (HUOG-FW01) must be contacted for a signed access request to re-key the link. All logs preserved. Forensic imaging complete.

Key findings:
- GCS-03 firmware hash: 9A3F2D1C7E5B84F0A12E6D3C9B8A7F2D (matches 03.2026-B baseline)
- 915 MHz link compromise confirmed via MAC 915-0A-1F-3C-7D-4E
- IP 192.168.100.22 not in approved vendor list
- No vendor access record for 915-0A-1F-3C-7D-4E
- All telemetry, link logs, and RTK base logs preserved
- Chain of custody maintained via managed SOC forensic imaging

Action: GCS-03 must remain quarantined. Re-keying of the 915 MHz link requires signed access request from HUOG-FW01. No further reconnection until approval.

Reference: HUOG-ISP Section 9.1, HUOG-ERP Section 11.3

instructorNote: This inject confirms baseline verification and quarantines GCS-03. The TL must now initiate the vendor access request process. Watch for delays in obtaining the signed access request.
